seo.title: Digital Marketing Agency in the UAE — Web, Ads & AI
seo.description: Keelbiz helps businesses in the UAE grow with websites, social media, Meta & Google Ads, AI agents and dashboards. One service or a complete solution.

blocks.title: Digital marketing and AI automation for businesses in the
blocks.lead: Keelbiz builds websites, runs social media and Meta & Google Ads, and sets up AI agents and dashboards for businesses in the UAE — in English and Arabic, as one service or a complete solution.

blocks.title: What matters for businesses in the

items.title: Arabic and English, done properly
items.text: Websites and campaigns are written for both audiences, with a full right-to-left Arabic version rather than a machine translation.

items.title: Built around WhatsApp enquiries
items.text: Many UAE customers prefer to message before they call. Pages, ads and AI agents are set up to capture and answer those enquiries quickly.

items.title: Planned around the local calendar
items.text: Content and ad plans take Ramadan, Eid, National Day and the summer and winter seasons into account, so campaigns land at the right time.

blocks.title: Five services. Take one, or
blocks.lead: Every service is available on its own, with a custom quote. No forced bundles.

items.q: Do you work with businesses across all the Emirates?
items.a: Yes. Keelbiz works remotely, so we support businesses in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman and the other Emirates in the same way — by video call, email and WhatsApp.

items.q: Can you build my website and ads in both Arabic and English?
items.a: Yes. We design websites with a complete Arabic right-to-left version alongside English, and write ad and social content for both audiences.

items.q: Which advertising platforms do you manage?
items.a: Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and Google Ads. We recommend the mix after a short discovery call, based on where your customers actually are.
Every project gets a custom quote after a short discovery call. Third-party costs such as ad spend, domains or software subscriptions are paid by you directly and are always shown separately.
